fragments.section: Sentences from dramas and social media
fragments.text:
Sentences from dramas and social media
My Korean notes. One rule: Korean = English.
fragments.topic: Sentences from dramas and social media

fragments.text:
Sentences
1. 오늘 하루도 수고 많았어요 = You worked hard today too.
People say it at the end of the day, like "good job today".
2. 나 너 때문에 진짜 웃었어 = I really laughed because of you.
3. 밥 먹었어? = Did you eat?
A way to say "how are you" to friends.
4. 이거 보고 너 생각나서 샀어 = I saw this and thought of you, so I bought it.
5. 주말에 시간 있으면 영화 보러 갈래? = If you have time this weekend, want to go see a movie?
6. 괜찮아, 다 잘될 거야 = It's okay, everything will be fine.

Sentences
7. 길이 막혀서 조금 늦을 것 같아요 = The road is jammed, so I think I'll be a little late.
8. 날씨가 너무 추워서 밖에 나가기 싫어요 = It's so cold that I don't want to go outside.
9. 사진 잘 나왔네요 = The photo came out well.
10. 요즘 이 노래만 계속 들어요 = These days I keep listening to this song only.
11. 너무 졸려서 커피를 두 잔이나 마셨어요 = I was so sleepy that I drank two whole cups of coffee.
12. 우리 언제 한번 밥 먹어요 = Let's eat together sometime.
Often polite small talk, not a real plan.

Sentences
13. 혹시 이 근처에 편의점 있어요? = Is there a convenience store near here, by any chance?
14. 생일 축하해, 행복한 하루 보내 = Happy birthday, have a happy day.
15. 이 옷 나한테 잘 어울려? = Do these clothes suit me?
16. 오랜만에 친구를 만나서 정말 좋았어요 = It was really nice to meet a friend after a long time.
17. 비 오는 날에는 집에서 쉬는 게 최고예요 = On rainy days, resting at home is the best.
18. 그 사람 목소리를 들으면 마음이 편해져요 = When I hear that person's voice, I feel at ease.

Sentences
19. 할 수 있어, 포기하지 마 = You can do it, don't give up.
20. 다음에 또 놀러 오세요 = Please come visit again next time.
